metadata.title: Monochrome Hip-Hop Portrait with Red Display Type

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white dual portrait featuring bold, blood-red sans-serif typography distributed across the composition.
excludeWhen: delicate or script typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: Two male figures in high-contrast grayscale, wearing luxury streetwear and accessories, framed by large-scale, flat red sans-serif lettering that occupies the corners and center-ground.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast grayscale subjects against a neutral gray background
Vibrant red typography providing the only color pop
Symmetrical distribution of text blocks around the subjects
Interaction between foreground figures and background-aligned text
coreInvariants: Heavyweight sans-serif font with wide tracking

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects side-by-side, waist-up, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central red text block and the subjects' eyewear.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern starting from top-left text, through the faces, to the bottom-left text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily in the upper center and around the edges of the figures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in subjects; flat, high-saturation red for text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in varying positions for rhythmic impact.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory badge in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, authoritative geometric structure.
Provides a similar industrial, bold weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of two men in luxury streetwear, one with hands in prayer, both wearing sunglasses, against a plain gray studio background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase red sans-serif text in the corners and center, using wide tracking and a geometric font like Helvetica Bold.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white except for the red text?
Is the text distributed across the corners and center?
Is the font a heavy, wide sans-serif?

mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on clothing
Specific facial features of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not obscure primary facial features.
Ensure the red is vibrant and consistent across all words.
Verify the parental advisory logo is present in the bottom right.
Confirm the background is a flat, neutral gray.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast BW portrait + Bold Red Geometric Sans-Serif + Perimeter Layout
